definition: a conspiracy or secret plan, esp. to achieve an unlawful end; an underhand plot; an evil design; machination.
example_en: They hatched a conspiracy against the king.

definition: that which causes wonder; a marvelous, amazing or wonderful thing.
example: ಆ ಜಾದೂಗಾರನ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ ನಿಜಕ್ಕೂ ಒಂದು ವಿಸ್ಮಯಕಾರಿ.
example_en: That magician's show was truly a marvel.

definition: an unduly adamant man.
example: ಚರ್ಚೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಪಂತಗಾಱ ಯಾರ ಮಾತೂ ಕೇಳಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: In the debate, that unduly adamant man listened to no one.

definition: to insult openly or purposely using scornful or sarcastic language; to affront; to taunt.
example_en: It is not right to insult him in front of everyone.

definition: a sequence of photographs or drawings, having a theme, story, etc., projected on a screen in such rapid succession that they create the optical illusion (because of the persistence of vision) of moving persons and objects; a film; a cinema.
example_en: The audience liked that film very much.

definition: a pencil of rays.
example_en: A pencil of the sun's rays came in through the window.

definition: removed from; disconnected from and taken away.
example_en: They removed the dishonest servant from the job.

definition: a lease of a property for a definite period period.
example_en: He took the land on a lease for a definite period.

definition: a room or building for exhibiting or dealing in artworks; an art-gallery.
example: ನಗರದ ಚಿತ್ರಗೃಹದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಚಿತ್ರಗಳ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was an exhibition of new paintings at the city's art gallery.

definition: a street where chiefly public shops are situated; a market-street; bazaar.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಕೇರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಜೆಯ ವೇಳೆ ಜನರಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿ ಹೋಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The market street was crowded with people in the evening.

definition: the pupil of the eye.
example_en: The doctor examined the pupil of the eye.

definition: the state of a person being alone; solitude; loneliness.
example_en: After retirement, loneliness troubled him.

definition: a kind of fried eatable made of bengal gram flour.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಸಂಜೆಗೆ ಬಿಸಿ ಬಿಸಿ ಬೋಂಡ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Mother made hot bonda for the evening.

definition: a useless talk; an empty, vain speech.
example_en: Everyone grew tired of hearing his useless talk.

definition: a clear, shrill sound made by whistling or blowing a whistle.
example_en: The referee's whistle sounded on the playing field.

definition: the position of a leader of a nation.
example_en: He was chosen for the position of leader of the nation.

definition: a steep water fall; a cascade.
example: ಪ್ರವಾಸಿಗರು ಆ ಧಬಧಬೆಯ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯ ನೋಡಿ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: The tourists were amazed seeing the beauty of that waterfall.

definition: a hemispherical roof or one formed by a series of rounded arches or vaults on a round or many-sided base; a large cupola; a dome.
example_en: That building's dome is very old.

definition: a solid mass of no special shape, esp. one small enough to be taken up in the hand; a lump.
example_en: There was a lump of clay in his hand.

definition: to be obstructedm or interrupted; (the flow) to be cut off.
example_en: The programme was interrupted due to the rain.

definition: a kind of ornament, resembling the open mouth of a crocodile.
example_en: She wore the crocodile-mouth-shaped ornament around her neck.

definition: a kind of cake.
example_en: On the festival day, grandmother prepared a kind of cake.

definition: a decoration made to a maṇṭapa with fruits, leaves, cloths, etc.
example_en: They have decorated the wedding pavilion with a decoration of fruits and leaves.

definition: a small quantity of liquid that is spherical or somewhat so; a drop.
example_en: A drop of dew was glistening on the leaf.

definition: this much quantity or number.
example_en: This much quantity of rice is enough for this cooking.

definition: the act or an instance of breaking another's arrogance, pride, haughtiness, etc.
example_en: The teacher's words caused the breaking of his arrogance.

definition: to take out.
example_en: He took the book out of the bag.

definition: the government of East India Company in India.
example_en: The East India Company government was ruling India at that time.

definition: the act or fact of being suspended from above.
example: ಆ ದೀಪದ ಲಂಬಿಕೆ ಛಾವಣಿಯಿಂದ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That lamp's suspension from the ceiling looked beautiful.

definition: a vehicle consisting of a tubular metal frame mounted on two large, wire-spoked wheels, one behind the other, and equipped with handlebars, a saddle like seat, and foot pedals; a bicycle.
example_en: The boy went to school on a bicycle.

definition: a large amphibian reptile of the family Crocodylidae, with the back and tail covered with large, square scales; a crocodile.
example_en: A large crocodile lay motionless in the pond.

definition: the sun.
example: ಕುಷಾಕು ಪ್ರಖರವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾಗ ನಾವು ನೆರಳಿಗೆ ಸರಿದೆವು.
example_en: When the sun was shining brightly, we moved to the shade.

definition: relatives and friends of the bridegroom.
example_en: The bridegroom's relatives and friends arrived at the wedding house.

definition: a sudden, convulsive, involuntary muscular contraction; spasm.
example_en: Suddenly his leg was hit by a spasm.

definition: sexual intercourse; coition.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇವು ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In that ancient text, the word kevu occurs.

definition: the act of jumping, leaping.
example: ಹುಡುಗ ಎತ್ತರದ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲಿಂದ ಲಾಗು ಹಾಕಿದನು.
example_en: The boy jumped down from the top of the tall wall.

definition: the plant Gossypium barbadense (= G. religiosum) of Malvaceae family.
example_en: People weave fine cloth from the Gossypium barbadense plant.

definition: that of which a thing consists; physical matter or material; substance.
example_en: There isn't much substance in this matter.

definition: the sun.
example_en: As the sun set, it became dark.

definition: a losing or being lost; loss.
example_en: The crop was ruined and the farmer suffered a loss.

definition: the taste that is bitter; the quality of being bitter; bitterness.
example: ಬೇವಿನ ಎಲೆಯ ಕಯ್ಪೆ ಬಾಯಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: The bitterness of the neem leaf still lingers in the mouth.

definition: the branch of physics dealing with sound, esp. with its transmission; acoustics.
example: ಧ್ವನಿಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಶಬ್ದದ ಉತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಸಾರವನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Acoustics studies the production and transmission of sound.

definition: a man of abnormally small stature; a dwarf.
example: ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ಕುಜ್ಜ ರಾಜನಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: In the story, a dwarf helps the king.

definition: a toothless mouth.
example_en: The old man looked at his grandson smiling with his toothless mouth.

definition: (only in comp.) ten.
example_en: In old Kannada, 'padi' means ten.

definition: a chequered cloth.
example_en: She wore a saree of chequered cloth.

definition: the plant Sphaeranthus indicus of Asteraceae family.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಮೋಟ ಗಿಡದ ಬೇರನ್ನು ಔಷಧಿಗೆ ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor used the root of the mota plant for medicine.

definition: to push out a liquid in drops continuously and forcefully.
example_en: Blood gushed out forcefully in drops from the wound.

definition: irrational governance; indiscreet, injudicious, imprudent management; prodigality.
example_en: Because of the irrational management, the institution fell into loss.

definition: a honorary professor of a university or college who occasionally visits for giving special lectures, expert views, etc.; a visiting professor.
example: ಆ ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾಲಯಕ್ಕೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಸಂದರ್ಶನಪ್ರಾಧ್ಯಾಪಕ ಉಪನ್ಯಾಸ ನೀಡಲು ಬಂದರು.
example_en: A visiting professor came to that university to give a lecture.

definition: a long, hard seat for several persons, with or without a back; a bench.
example_en: The children sat on the bench in the park.

definition: a very young child; a baby; an infant.
example_en: She sang a lullaby and put the baby to sleep.

definition: transacting six times the quantity.
example_en: He earned six times the profit in the business.

definition: a place, seat, etc. that befits an invitee.
example_en: They gave him a seat of honour befitting an invitee in the assembly.

definition: the earning of one's livelihood.
example_en: He is earning his livelihood with difficulty.

definition: a faint, indistinct appearance (of an object).
example_en: In the fog, only a faint outline of the house was visible.

definition: collection of revenues, taxes due to the government.
example_en: Collection of revenue from farmers has begun.

definition: sediment accumulated on the bottom of a lake, water tank, water well, etc.
example_en: A lot of sediment had accumulated at the bottom of the lake.

definition: an organising or being organised; organisation.
example: ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಮುಂಜಾನೆ ನಾನು ಒಂದು ಮೈಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತೇನೆ.
example_en: Every morning I walk one mile.

definition: the red colour.
example: ಅವಳ ಸೀರೆಯ ಲೋಹಿನಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The red colour of her sari drew everyone's attention.

definition: a young child.
example_en: The young child slept in its mother's lap.

definition: a four-stringed, musical instrument, that gives the base pitch.
example_en: He sang while playing the bancara instrument.

definition: a colossal, gigantic form.
example_en: Krishna showed Arjuna his colossal cosmic form.

definition: to communicate through spoken words; to tell; to utter; to say.
example_en: He told his story.

definition: (pl.) two ways, manners or types.
example_en: There are two types of events in that story.

definition: the state of being exhausted from physical or mental effort; tiredness.
example_en: Tiredness set in after working the whole day.

definition: a man who has won, conquered; a victor.
example: ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆದ್ದ ಆ ವೀರನನ್ನು ಜಿಷ್ಣು ಎಂದು ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: They called that warrior who won the battle a jishnu.

definition: a paying of what is due.
example_en: He paid off the loan due on time.

definition: agreement in feeling, action, ideas, interests, etc.; peaceable or friendly relations; harmony; an association marked by compatibility.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸಹೋದರರ ನಡುವೆ ಹೊದ್ದುಗೆ ಎಂದೆಂದಿಗೂ ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Harmony remained forever between the two brothers.

definition: to remove (a plant) by pulling out (its) roots.
example_en: The farmer uprooted the weeds completely.

definition: the armed force of a state.
example_en: The armed force stood ready at the border.

definition: a bunch of leaves.
example_en: They tied a bunch of leaves at the doorway for the worship.

definition: greatness; glory.
example: ಆ ರಾಜನ ಮಹಾವಿಭೂತಿ ಇಡೀ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That king's greatness was known to the whole world.

definition: the red colour of evening twilight.
example_en: The red colour of evening twilight looked beautiful in the western sky.

definition: a girl adopted into one's own family by legal process as a daughter.
example_en: They took an adopted daughter from the orphanage.

definition: a flat piece of wood, often carved, placed in between a pillar and the beam of a house.
example: ಬಡಗಿ ಕಂಬದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೊಮಾರವನ್ನು ಭದ್ರವಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The carpenter fixed the wooden block firmly on the pillar.

definition: a well settled life.
example_en: They were leading a well settled life in the village.

definition: the last point; the final point; end; apex; maximum or minimum level; extreme point;
example_en: The end of the journey was drawing near.

definition: to stick (oneself) to; to adhere to; to get fixed or attached to.
example_en: The child stuck itself to its mother's sari end.

definition: (skin) to become wrinkled.
example_en: The fruit left in the sun quickly became wrinkled.

definition: engrossed, absorbed in.
example_en: He was engrossed in reading the book.

definition: the inner portion; interior.
example_en: A lot of pain was hidden in his inner being.

definition: a woman who spends money extravagantly or wastefully; prodigal; a spendthrift.
example: ದಂದೂರಿ ಹೆಂಗಸು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಹಣವನ್ನು ವ್ಯರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The spendthrift woman wasted all the money.

definition: to churn using a churning stick.
example_en: The grandmother sat churning the curd with a churning stick.

definition: (dial.) an elementary learning-book used by beginners learning alphabets and the numbers.
example_en: They gave the child an elementary learning-book and taught it to read.

definition: a kind of sugar.
example_en: Rayapudi sugar is needed for the sweet dish.

definition: excessively; greatly; abundantly.
example_en: He spends money excessively.

definition: a kind of spicy pudding fried in oil.
example_en: Mother fried the spicy fritters for the evening.

definition: land on either side and along a river; bank.
example_en: The fishermen were drying their nets on the river bank.

definition: to regain consciousness, after being unconscious for some time.
example_en: The wounded soldier regained consciousness soon after.

definition: a nerve that carry impulses away from a nerve centre; an efferent nerve.
example_en: The efferent nerve carries the brain's command to the muscles.

definition: a letter or its enclosure, sent through an envelope (through postal service).
example_en: The postman delivered the letter to the house.

definition: to pluck in a very rough manner.
example: ಅವನು ಕೋಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಿಡದ ಎಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಿರಿ ಬಿಸಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: In anger, he roughly plucked the plant's leaves and threw them away.

definition: the act of killing, chopping or mincing of a sheep.
example_en: Slaughtering a sheep for the festival is customary in the village.

definition: the distance from the tip of the great toe to the back of the heel.
example_en: His foot length came out exactly to measure.

definition: a degenerative disease in an organ of the body, esp. the liver, marked by excess formation of connective tissue and, usually, subsequent painful swelling; cirrhosis.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಅರಿಶಿನಾರಿಗೆ ರೋಗ ಇರುವುದಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctor told him that he had cirrhosis.

definition: the quality of being broad or wide; breadth; width.
example: ಈ ಕಣಿವೆಯ ವಿಸ್ತೃತ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was amazed at the breadth of this valley.

definition: to expel (gas) through the mouth from the stomach; to eruct; to belch.
example_en: The baby belched after drinking milk.

definition: the quail Perdicula asiatica of Phasianidae family, with brown body and wings, black and grey stripes on the breast, short grey beak, short tail, that nests on the ground; jungle bush-quail.
example_en: The jungle bush-quail was searching for food in the grass in pairs.

definition: a strong case for keeping out the water while foundations for a bridge is being built; a caisson.
example: ಸೇತುವೆಯ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂತರ್ಜಲ ಸಂಪುಟವನ್ನು ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಳಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: For the bridge work, they lowered the caisson into the water.

definition: until this time; till today; to now; hitherto.
example: ಈವರಂ ಅವನು ಈ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಏನೂ ಹೇಳಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Until now, he had said nothing about this.

definition: modern usage, trends, expression or trait; modern spirit of character; modernism.
example_en: This building is a symbol of modernism.

definition: any of a family (Chamaeleontidae) of chiefly arboreal Old World lizards with prehensile tail, independently movable eyeballs, and unusual ability to change the colour of the skin; a chameleon.
example: ಒಂತಿಯು ತನ್ನ ಬಾಲದಿಂದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯನ್ನು ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಹಿಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The chameleon held the branch tightly with its tail.

definition: an otter-like carnivorous animal with webbed feet used in swimming.
example_en: An otter was swimming near the riverbank.

definition: a man of profound knowledge.
example_en: Everyone respected that teacher as a man of profound knowledge.

definition: (pros.) a kind of alliteration.
example_en: The poet used alliteration and made the verse beautiful.

definition: to cause to be caught, arrested.
example_en: The police had the thief caught and arrested.

definition: a group or association of kings.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ರಾಜಮಂಡಲ ಒಂದಾಗಿ ಕೂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A great association of kings had gathered together in that region.

definition: to get one's name, reputation sullied, spoiled; to be tarnished.
example_en: His reputation was sullied by that accusation.

definition: the quality or condition of being stupid; stupidity.
example_en: Out of stupidity, he caused himself a great loss.

definition: a kind of pigment, bright-red mercuric sulfide; vermilion.
example_en: They applied a tilak using vermilion for the puja.

definition: to slide or slip in a puddle.
example_en: The child slipped and fell in the puddle.

definition: to cause to cough.
example_en: The spicy smoke made the child cough.

definition: to look at or into critically or methodically in order to find out the facts, condition, etc. of; to examine; to test.
example_en: The officer carefully examined the documents.

definition: a schedule or statement giving details of the heirs for the property of a deceased, and the share of it each one is eligible for.
example_en: The lawyer prepared the schedule of heirs and their shares.

definition: the dicotyledon plant Vigna unguiculata (= V. catjang, = V. sinensis, = Dolichos sinensis, = D, catjang) of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The farmer sowed cowpea seeds in the field.

definition: the return of an injury for an injury, in punishment or retribution; avenging of an injury or offence; revenge; vengeance.
example_en: He took revenge for the insult he had suffered.

definition: an act or spell of struggling; a continued effort to resist force or free oneself from constraint; a strong effort under difficulties; struggle.
example_en: He kept struggling to free himself.

definition: to communicate through spoken words; to tell; to utter; to say.
example_en: He told about his experience.

definition: that which moves in water; fish or any aquatic animal.
example_en: The fisherman caught the fish in his net.

definition: either of the two feathered forelimbs of a bird, for flight, balance in running, for swimming, etc.; a wing.
example_en: The bird's wings made a noise in the wind.

definition: (said of flower) to close the petals.
example_en: As evening fell, that flower closed its petals.

definition: a strong, unpleasant, offensive smell; stink; stench.
example_en: A stench from the garbage heap spread all around.

definition: a man with agitated, perturbed mind.
example: ಆ ಕುದುಕುಳಿ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಏನನ್ನೋ ಯೋಚಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಇರುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That man with an agitated mind is always thinking about something.

definition: a rolling of oneself on the ground round a temple or up to a considerable distance, as a religious vow or penance.
example: ಭಕ್ತನು ಹರಕೆಯಂತೆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಸುತ್ತ ಮಡಸ್ತನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The devotee performed the rolling penance around the temple as per his vow.

definition: anything worn to adorn, decorate the body; an ornament.
example_en: They put a gold ornament on the child.

definition: a variety of paddy.
example_en: The somasali variety of paddy gives a good yield.

definition: to defraud; to cheat; to deceive.
example_en: He even deceived his friend and stole money.

definition: a false statement or action, made with intent to deceive; a lie.
example: ಅವನು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದೆಲ್ಲಾ ಹುಸಿ ಎಂದು ನಂತರ ತಿಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: Later it was found that everything he said was a lie.

definition: the administrative head of a district.
example_en: The administrative head of the district was looking after the district's administration.

definition: darkly; blackly; gloomingly.
example_en: His skin turned dark in the sun.

definition: to be forced to pay.
example_en: The debtor is forced to pay interest.

definition: a measure of four seers.
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಒಂದು ಪಾಯಲಿ ಅಕ್ಕಿಯನ್ನು ತೂಕ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The shopkeeper weighed out one measure of four seers of rice.

definition: to come to an end; to end.
example_en: The meeting will come to an end at five in the evening.

definition: (hist.) a kind of tax.
example: ಪೊಮ್ಮು ಎಂಬ ತೆರಿಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The tax called pommu is found in old records.

definition: an overflowing of water on an area normally dry; inundation; deluge; flood.
example_en: Due to heavy rain, a flood occurred in the village.

definition: a number of persons or things gathered closely together; a group; a cluster; an agregation.
example_en: A group of people had gathered together in the marketplace.

definition: the state of having or consisting of organs.
example_en: Scientists explained the state of having organs in living beings.

definition: Kubēra, the regent of Northern quarter, who also is the god of riches and treasure.
example_en: Devotees worship Kubera, the lord of riches, for wealth.

definition: a formal sending of or being sent (from a place, employment, any sphere of activity, etc.); a farewell.
example: ನಿವೃತ್ತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಸಹೋದ್ಯೋಗಿಗಳು ಅವನಿಗೆ ವಿದಾಯ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: After his retirement, his colleagues bade him farewell.

definition: (myth.) the twelfth of the fourteen Manus, the forefathers of human race.
example_en: Rudrasūkta is the twelfth of the fourteen Manus.

definition: a flock of fireflies.
example_en: At evening a flock of fireflies twinkled in the garden.

definition: complete destruction; annihilation.
example_en: There are many stories about the great annihilation in the Puranas.

definition: the religious bathing preparatory to religious rites at the time of coronation.
example_en: The religious bathing was performed for the king before the coronation.

definition: to become abundant, superfluous.
example_en: Weeds became superfluous in the field and troubled the crop.

definition: the act or process of weeping.
example_en: Everyone felt pity seeing her weeping.

definition: a frying pan.
example_en: The frying pan was placed on the stove in the kitchen.

definition: a woman who is beloved (to a man).
example_en: She was the woman beloved to him.

definition: a washing of the body in water; bath.

definition: to cause to extinguish or to put out (fire, a burning lamp etc.).

definition: a worshipping of elders or one's ancestors.

example_en: Even after sleeping enough, her drowsiness did not go away.

definition: the lord of the earth; a king.

definition: to cause to jump, leap forward; to make something spring up or forward.

definition: that which has been hatched by a crow; a cuckoo.

definition: (beauty, natural form) to deteriorate or be lost.
example_en: As she aged, her beauty deteriorated.

definition: the act of cooking, boiling well.

definition: a man appointed to (a post, position, office, etc.) or entrusted with (something).

definition: of Portugal, its people, their language or culture; Portuguese.

definition: one who holds the exclusive right for a term of years to the proceeds of an invention; a patent-holder.

definition: the quality, state or fact of being eternal; continuance without end; eternity.

example_en: The grandfather now has a grandson.

definition: distress or uneasiness of mind caused by fear of danger or misfortune.

definition: the process of taking air into the lungs and letting it out; an inhaling and exhaling.

definition: to increase to result in being three times the original quantity, number, area, etc.

definition: other than; besides; from.

definition: the tapered crest or summit of a hill or mountain; a peak.
example_en: Mist had covered the mountain peak.

example_en: His fame had spread throughout the town.

definition: an object or end that one strives to attain; an aim; a goal.

definition: (pros.) a kind of metre.

definition: the quality of being very tiny, minute or subtle; subtleness.

definition: to be lustreless; to be dim.

definition: to cause to pierce through; to plant (a pointed instrument) into.

definition: a written statement, account, declaration, assertion or explanation.
example_en: The written declaration was clearly written in that document.

definition: a shoot or tendril (of a creeper).
example_en: The creeper's tendril swayed in the wind.

definition: state of being a mother-in-law.
example: ಮಗನ ಮದುವೆಯ ನಂತರ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಅತ್ತೆತನ ದೊರೆಯಿತು.
example_en: After her son's marriage, she gained the status of being a mother-in-law.

definition: deserving or causing ridicule; ridiculous; absurd.
example_en: His behaviour was ridiculous.

definition: the actual fact; the fact that is not distorted.
example_en: The factual accuracy of that report must be verified.

definition: a baseless accusation or vilification.
example_en: They put a baseless accusation on him.

definition: to hand over to; to give; to submit; to offer; to furnish.
example_en: He submitted all the documents to the office.

definition: a liquefied resinous substance secreted by various scale insects, esp. a species (Laccifer lacca) of India, that live on certain fig, soapberry, and acacia trees, formerly used by women to dye their soles, feet, breast, etc.; lac; shellac.
example: ಹಿಂದೆ ಮಹಿಳೆಯರು ಅಲತಗೆಯಿಂದ ತಮ್ಮ ಅಂಗಾಲಿಗೆ ಬಣ್ಣ ಹಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In the past, women used to apply lac to dye their soles.

definition: (astrol.) (pl.) the nine planets that supposedly rule the destiny of all beings.
example_en: The astrologer explained about the nine planets.

definition: the quality or fact of being round, circular.
example_en: The roundness of that vessel was beautiful to look at.

definition: packed food for a journey.
example_en: When setting out on the journey, mother packed food for the trip.

definition: a steel shoe nailed to the hoofs of horses.
example_en: They had nailed a steel shoe to the horse's hoof.

definition: the state of being liberated from worldly existence or transmigration; final emancipation.
example_en: The saint attained final emancipation.

definition: a wooden or metal bar to fasten the door or window panel; a latch.
example: ಗಾಳಿ ಬೀಸಿದಾಗ ಬಾಗಿಲಿನ ಲಾಳವಂಡಿಗೆ ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: When the wind blew, the door's latch made a noise.

definition: to utter; to speak.
example_en: He spoke out in anger.

definition: the lotus flower.
example_en: The lotus flower had bloomed in the pond.

definition: a small piece, fragment or pieces, fragments (of something).
example: ಒಡೆದ ಬಳಪದ ಹಱಿಹಂಚು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The fragments of the broken slate pencil lay on the ground.

definition: a physician who cures illness; a medical doctor.
example: ಆ ರೋಗಹಾರಿ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That physician was treating the villagers.

definition: a musical mode.
example_en: The musician sang the raga Devanadottara.

definition: the surface of the earth.
example_en: The surface of the earth is divided into different regions.

definition: tapering to a point; pointed.
example_en: The tip of that stick was pointed.

definition: any of various families of tailless, leaping anuran amphibians with long, powerful hind legs, short forelegs, a smooth skin, and webbed feet, and that, when grown, are able to live both in water and on land; a frog.
example_en: The frog leapt in the pond.

definition: a large, mounted piece of artillery; a cannon.
example_en: The soldiers fired the cannon at the enemies.

definition: a covert watching (as by a detective, policeman, etc.).
example_en: The police kept covert watch on the thieves.

definition: not sure of; not definite; uncertain.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ಮೊಗಂ ಆಗಿದೆ, ಖಚಿತವಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That news is still uncertain; it is not confirmed.

definition: a famous, well-known, place.
example_en: That temple was a famous, well-known place in the whole kingdom.

definition: (children's term) a wound.
example_en: There was a wound on the child's hand.
She kept her clothes separated from others'.

definition: the act of separating one from another or others; the fact of being separated from others; separation; segregation.
example_en: A separation occurred between the two friends.

definition: a hindrance; an obstacle; an impediment.
example_en: The plan has faced yet another obstacle.

definition: a tooth that is twisted or grown over another or is of a shape that is different from normal.
example: ಆ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ವಿಕೃತದಂತ ಇರುವುದು ಕಾಣಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That child was seen to have a twisted, oddly grown tooth.

definition: having more breadth or width; broad; wide.
example_en: The bank of that river was spread out broad.

definition: the waste matter of the town.
example_en: The town's waste matter must be removed and carried away every day.

definition: the moral, social tendency of or religious vow of, abstaining from harming, causing violence.
example_en: Gandhiji preached the religion of non-violence.

definition: any of the games, movements, amusements of children.
example_en: Everyone laughs seeing the child's play.
